decisions.hidden_reasoning:
I'm sizing up the matchup, picking three from our side against their Rotom, Torkoal, Torterra, Scrafty, Alcremie, and Appletun lineup. Incineroar looks like a strong lead with intimidate and fake out, and I'm weighing Kingambit's Dark/Steel typing since Steel covers Fairy threats like Alcremie while Dark hits back against their other picks.

I'm leaning toward Incineroar, Kingambit, and Garchomp as the trio, since Garchomp handles Torkoal and Torterra well, though I'm wary that Appletun and Alcremie's typing could threaten Garchomp through Dragon and Fairy attacks respectively.

decisions.thought: 48% SWITCH: torkoal, 18% MOVE: discharge, 10% MOVE: charge

Fake Out does nothing because Rotom is Ghost-type and immune to Normal moves. Flare Blitz is a poor trade since Incineroar is slower and Rotom can hit first. Parting Shot cuts Rotom's Attack and Special Attack and brings in Kingambit, which resists Ghost and punishes Rotom's Electric/Ghost typing.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Right, Fake Out is Normal-type and Rotom is part Ghost, so it's completely immune — that move does nothing here. I need to consider other options like Flare Blitz instead.

Parting Shot could switch out safely into Kingambit or Gholdengo, lowering Rotom's Attack and Special Attack in the process. If Kingambit comes in against Rotom, its Dark-type Sucker Punch and Kowtow Cleave hit Ghost super effectively, making that a strong follow-up.

Also checking Ghost-type coverage against Kingambit: Dark/Steel actually resists Ghost, so that's not a concern. I'll go with Parting Shot.

decisions.thought: 25% SWITCH: rotom, 23% SWITCH: torterra, 19% MOVE: flamecharge

Torkoal's Whitesmoke blocked Parting Shot on turn 1, so that option is dead. Flare Blitz is only resisted by Torkoal's Fire typing, and Kingambit resists Fire while Iron Head hits Torkoal super effectively. Kingambit also outspeeds Torkoal, so switching in is the best line.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Against Torkoal, Flare Blitz is resisted since both are Fire types, so that's not a great option; Torkoal's Overheat or Eruption could hurt, but it's slow. Parting Shot might be better here, letting me switch into Kingambit or Gholdengo.

Kingambit and Gholdengo both resist Fire as Steel-types, so switching to either blunts Torkoal's offense while hitting back hard with super-effective Steel moves — Kingambit's Iron Head especially stands out given Torkoal's shaky physical bulk despite its high Defense stat.

decisions.thought: 75% SWITCH: torkoal, 9% MOVE: discharge, 5% MOVE: charge

decisions.hidden_reasoning: Dark is super effective against Ghost-type Rotom, so Kingambit's Kowtow Cleave with Black Glasses boost hits hard here, benefiting from STAB and the type advantage.
